findings.title: Settra Ransomware: TTPs, Victims, and Defense Guide
findings.summary_md: MOXFIVE threat intelligence reported tracking the Settra ransomware and data extortion group since late June 2026, when the group posted nearly two dozen victims to its Tor leak site, and confirmed it remained active as of July 16, 2026. Incident case work tied initial access to compromised VPN credentials, followed by NetExec and Netscan for discovery, Procdump and Mimikatz for credential theft, PAExec for lateral movement, an edr_blind tool for disabling endpoint detection, the signed STProcessMonitor_v114.sys vulnerable driver for BYOVD privilege escalation, and Mesh Agent for persistent access. The post attributes no activity to a specific country or industry, noting the group states it targets organizations with unpatched systems and weak access management.
